decision_conditions: The proposed new roof and outbuilding, would by virtue of their design, scale, siting, form, and visually jarring combination, give rise to an awkward, incongruous, bulky and overbearing form of over-development that would unbalance and detract from the character and would harmfully erode the character and appearance of the host dwelling at rear and front, and would be detrimental to the appearance of the streetscene in this location. Therefore, it is contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), to Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), to Policy CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010), and to Policies DMD6, DMD12, DMD13 and DMD37 of the Development Management Document (2014).

Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that the proposed development would be safe from flooding and would not increase flood risk elsewhere. The submitted Flood Risk Assessment fails to demonstrate that adequate finished floor levels and flood compensation measures would be provided, having regard to the site's identified risk of fluvial and surface water flooding. Furthermore, no Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS) measures have been proposed to promote and manage sustainable drainage across the site. The Local Planning Authority has therefore not been provided with a suitable basis upon which to assess the flood risk and drainage implications of the development. The proposal is consequently contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies CP1 and CP28 of the Core Strategy (2010), Policies SI12 and SI13 of the London Plan (2021), and Policies DMD59, DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62 of the Development Management Document (2014).
description: Erection of new roof with dormer, front rooflights and erection of outbuilding.
